title: Hooded figures spraying plague from landed craft

tellings.quote: that Braramley did is that he found that the plague broke out only after these people would land in the fields, come out of these objects, land in, and they would go around with these hoods on and these spray cans that became the basis for the sid and the grim reaper image.

plain: The plague in Europe broke out only after beings landed in the fields, came out of their craft and walked around wearing hoods and carrying spray cans, and this, the claim goes, is where the image of the scythe and the grim reaper comes from. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this from the writer William Bramley's book The Gods of Eden, presenting it as what Bramley found. If true, it would mean the plague was spread on purpose by visitors from elsewhere.
